answer: Locks are published in tundra, expire in mesa, and summit lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 119 aliases hence needs 16 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4102 identities would post 3080 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
